svg.aria-label: Enum alignment anchors: mir-lower raises an enum storage type's alignment with a zero-length integer array whose width was align times 8 with no bound; from align 2^21 the width exceeded LLVM's limit and at 2^29 it wrapped to i0. PR 1357 caps the anchor at i128, the Rust alignment stays on every memory operation, and one helper now serves unions and enums

text.style: font: 600 17px var(--sans); fill: var(--fg); white-space: pre

svg.text: Enum alignment anchors: the zero-length anchor is capped at 16 bytes ([0 x i128])

text.style: font: 400 12.5px var(--sans); fill: var(--muted); white-space: pre

svg.text: mir-lower raises an enum storage type's natural alignment with a zero-length integer array. Its width was align * 8 with no bound; the cap is the one unions got in #610.

text.style: font: 600 11px var(--sans); fill: var(--muted); white-space: pre

svg.text: THE ENUM AND ITS ANCHOR (what mir-lower mints)

text.style: font: 600 11px var(--sans); fill: var(--muted); white-space: pre

svg.text: BEFORE (the width grows with the alignment, then breaks)

text.style: font: 600 11px var(--sans); fill: var(--muted); white-space: pre

svg.text: AFTER #1357 (one cap, stamped alignment, one helper)

svg.text: valid; the same anchor after the fix. Align 8 and 16 are the controls.

svg.text: valid IR but no alignment gained: our data layout strings stop at

text.style: font: 400 10.5px var(--sans); fill: var(--muted); white-space: pre

svg.text: i128:128, so opt saw 16; llc's default NVPTX layout has i256:256: 32.

text.style: font: 400 10.5px var(--sans); fill: var(--muted); white-space: pre

svg.text: (i8388608 is the last accepted); at 2^29, (2^29 * 8) as u32 == 0.

svg.text: What changes and what does not

text.style: font: 400 11.5px var(--sans); fill: var(--fg); white-space: pre

svg.text: Changes: only the anchor's element width for alignments of 32 and up (i256, i512, i1024, i8388608 and i0 all become i128). Unchanged: size, stride, and the alignment

text.style: font: 400 11.5px var(--sans); fill: var(--fg); white-space: pre

svg.text: stamped on the memory operations. Enums aligned 2^20, 2^21 and 2^29 go from exit 101 on main to building and running; align 32 to 128 keep the same PTX. A wider anchor never bought alignment.
